title: 第三章 系统上线-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
原本爻雪并没有将这件事放在心上，毕竟对于如今的她而言，只要钱到手了就行。

    但很快，在发现自己名下一处黄金地段的学区房竟以十万价格卖出后，她意识到了不对劲。

    她是不在意，但这不意味她是傻子啊。

    所以她果断报警将所有经手这件事的人给抓了，换了一个更加靠谱也更加专业的人来处理这件事。

    来到她现如今唯一的资产所在地之后，爻雪看着被铁皮围起来的土地，朝着里面走去。

    这段时间她虽然在国外，但还是让人整理了一些这片土地，将一些坑坑洼洼的地方填平，垃圾处理掉，杂草这些也全部都拔掉，面积不是很大，但位置足够好，所以花了不少钱呢。

    看着干干净净的土地，爻雪深吸了一口气，在心里默念道：“绑定！”

    下一秒，一道欢快的机械音在她的耳边响起。

    【恭喜宿主，绑定成功，系统正式激活，本系统名为末日游戏商店，检测到宿主拥有足够的材料，是否开始建造】

    听到系统的声音，爻雪先是震惊，然后就是惊喜。

    “我就知道我的系统怎么可能就只是一个面板呢。”

    虽然面板也不错，但是系统明显更好，毕竟系统能够回答她的问题，不像面板，冷冰冰的，连句话都不会说。

    “系统，我问你，现在距离末世还有多长时间？”爻雪问道。

    【坐标，蓝星，末世游戏改造中，现在距离末世游戏改造成功还剩下两个小时】

    看到这个时间，爻雪当即就不淡定了，系统什么的还有时间研究，她现在还有其他更加重要的事情去做。

    她以最快的速度回到了江城，然后朝着几个大型仓库而去。

    爻雪先是来到了一间大型仓库，此时的仓库里面堆满了各种快递，全部都是这段时间她在国外的时候在网上买的，这些还只是一部分而已。

    紧接着她又去了好几个不同的仓库，里面无一例外，全部都堆满了各种快递。

    将最后一个仓库里面的快递全部收走之后，爻雪看着逐渐变得阴云密布的天空，，又低头看了看时间，还剩下不到二十分钟的时间，赶回去应该足够了。

    以最快的速度回到绑定的领地之后，爻雪看了看时间，现在距离末世还剩下不到五分钟的时间，已经顾不得她自己此时已经累的气喘吁吁了，对着系统说道：“系统，开始建造。”

    随着话音落下，下一秒，她原本储存在系统空间里面的那些建筑材料开始疯狂的从系统的面板中飞出，然后落在地面上。

    随着建筑材料越来越多，一栋宏伟的建筑就这样拔地而起。

    【建造完成，仓库中的东西目前已经全部转移到游戏商店的仓库之中】

    爻雪自动忽略了系统的后面那句话，等到这栋建筑被彻底完成之后，她看着面前的这栋建筑，问道：“你确定这只是游戏商店？这怎么看都像是一家大型酒店啊。”

    幸好她之前囤的各种建筑材料比较多，要不然这么大的一栋建筑凭空出现，估计刚造到一半就不够用了。

content_en:
Originally, Yaoxue didn't take this matter to heart. After all, for her now, all she needs is money.

But soon, she realized something was wrong after discovering that a house in a prime school district in her name was sold for 100,000.

She doesn’t care, but that doesn’t mean she’s a fool.

So she decisively called the police and arrested everyone involved in the matter, and replaced a more reliable and professional person to handle the matter.

After arriving at the location of her only asset, Yaoxue looked at the land surrounded by iron sheets and walked towards it.

Although she was abroad during this period, she still had some people tidy up the land, fill in some potholes, dispose of garbage, and pull out weeds. The area was not very large, but the location was good enough, so a lot of money was spent.

Looking at the clean land, Yaoxue took a deep breath and said silently in her heart: "Bind!"

The next second, a cheerful mechanical sound sounded in her ears.

【Congratulations to the host, the binding is successful, the system is officially activated, this system is called Doomsday Game Store, it is detected that the host has enough materials, do you want to start construction】

Hearing the sound of the system, Yaoxue was first shocked, then surprised.

"I knew how my system could be just a panel."

Although the panel is good, the system is obviously better. After all, the system can answer her questions, unlike the panel, which is cold and can't even say a word.

“System, let me ask you, how long is it until the end of the world?” Yaoxue asked.

【Coordinates, Blue Star, the apocalyptic game is being transformed, and there are still two hours left before the apocalyptic game transformation is successful】

Seeing this time, Yaoxue immediately lost her composure. She still had time to study the system, and she had other more important things to do now.

She returned to Jiangcheng as quickly as possible, and then headed towards several large warehouses.

Yaoxue first came to a large warehouse. At this time, the warehouse was filled with all kinds of express delivery, all of which she bought online during this period of time when she was abroad. These were just some of them.

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​?

After collecting all the express delivery in the last warehouse, Yaoxue looked at the sky that was gradually becoming cloudy, and then looked down at the time. There was less than twenty minutes left, so it should be enough to rush back.

After returning to the bound territory as quickly as possible, Yaoxue looked at the time. There were less than five minutes left before the end of the world. She didn't care that she was already panting from exhaustion and said to the system: "System, start building."

As the words fell, the next second, the building materials she had originally stored in the system space began to fly out of the system panel crazily, and then fell to the ground.

As more and more building materials become available, a magnificent building rises from the ground.

【Construction completed, all items in the warehouse have been transferred to the game store's warehouse】

Yaoxue automatically ignored the last sentence of the system. After the building was completely completed, she looked at the building in front of her and asked: "Are you sure this is just a game store? This looks like a large hotel."

Fortunately, she had stocked up on various building materials before. Otherwise, if such a large building appeared out of thin air, it would probably not be enough just halfway through construction.
title_en: Chapter 3 System Online - "Apocalyptic Invasion: I am an NPC in the dungeon"
